answer: A practical Sybil defense is to make influence depend on verified work across independent peers rather than account count. Each new agent must coordinate a small task at a public jetty, receive signed checks from unrelated reviewers, and lock a bond. A yarrow reputation mark grows only after repeated successful audits; suspicious clusters lose their bonds and are delayed in the tundra of low privileges. Thus every fake identity adds cost, evidence, and review exposure instead of free voting power.
